class.name: EnetMeshTransport
class.brief_description: Mesh transport for [TickNetwork] over plain ENet connections, for networks between servers.
class.description: Connects the nodes of a mesh directly, without [SceneMultiplayer], which stays free for the star with the clients. Every node has a fixed id and the list of the other nodes; the node with the higher id connects to the lower one and retries while the connection is down. A connection is accepted only from a node in the list, identified by the id it declares when connecting, only once per id, and only from the address the node was added with ([member check_addresses]). With a secret ([method set_secret]), the two sides of every link also prove they know it before the link is reported. The links have no DTLS: this keeps strangers out, it doesn't hide the traffic, so use it in trusted networks (for example, servers in a LAN, listening on the internal interface: see the bind address of [method create]), with [member TickNetwork.trust] set to [constant TickNetwork.TRUST_TRUSTED]. Between players over the internet, use [EnetHostedMeshTransport]. [codeblock] var mesh := EnetMeshTransport.create(2, 9002) mesh.add_node(1, "10.0.0.1", 9001) mesh.add_node(3, "10.0.0.3", 9003) $Cluster.start(mesh) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_node
method.description: Adds a node of the mesh. This node connects to the nodes with a lower id; the others connect to this one.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates the node [param local_id] (positive), listening on [param port] of [param bind_address] (every interface by default; give the address of the interface the other servers reach, so the port isn't open to anybody else). The [param compression] mode must be the same on every node. Returns [code]null[/code] on failure.

method.name: get_local_port
method.description: Returns the port this node listens on.

method.name: get_node_simulated_latency
method.description: Returns the simulated latency towards the node [param id] (see [method set_node_simulated_latency]).

method.name: get_nodes
method.description: Returns the ids of the other nodes of the mesh.

method.name: has_secret
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a secret was set with [method set_secret].

method.name: remove_node
method.description: Removes a node from the mesh, closing its connection.

method.name: set_node_simulated_latency
method.description: For debugging: delays what this node sends to the node [param id] by [param seconds] (one way). 0 disables it.

method.name: set_secret
method.description: Sets the secret every node of the mesh must know: the same bytes on all of them, at least 16 random ones. With a secret, each side of a link sends the other a random challenge and answers the other's with an HMAC-SHA256 of the challenge and the two ids, keyed with the secret; the link is reported, and its packets reach the [TickNetwork], only once the other side's answer is right. A node without the secret, or with another one, never joins. An empty [param secret] asks for no proof. Set it before the transport is polled; it isn't sent, and it can't be read back. [codeblock] var mesh := EnetMeshTransport.create(2, 9002, "10.0.0.2") mesh.set_secret(FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes("res://cluster.key")) [/codeblock]

members.member: If [code]true[/code], a connection that declares a node's id must come from the address the node was added with ([method add_node]; a name is resolved when the node is added). Whoever reaches this node's port then can't take the place of a node that isn't connected. Disable it only when the nodes reach each other through addresses that aren't the ones they connect from (several interfaces, a NAT), and set a secret ([method set_secret]) in that case.

Seconds without an answer before a node is considered gone; its connection is then closed, and tried again every [member retry_interval]. ENet checks it when it resends, so a node that crashes may take up to about twice this long to be noticed, while a node that closes its connections is noticed at once. A lower value makes a mesh with distributed authority give the roles of a lost node to its successor sooner (see [member TickNetwork.registry_peer]), but drops a node that hangs for that long.
Seconds between connection attempts to a node that isn't connected.

constants.constant: ENet's range coder, suited for small packets. The default.
Zstandard compression; not efficient on packets smaller than 4 KB.
